last.verdict: Shopify held 32% revenue growth while operating income jumped 66%, and guided to similar growth next quarter.

takeaways.label: Profit outgrowing sales
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 66% to $568 million on 32% revenue growth. Free cash flow margin reached 22%, up from 18% a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Steady growth outlook
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to grow at a low-thirties rate, matching this quarter. Free cash flow margin is guided to match last year's fourth quarter.

takeaways.label: Gross profit lags revenue
takeaways.text: Gross profit grew 28% versus 32% for revenue, and fourth-quarter gross profit is guided to high-twenties growth, so more sales come from lower-margin payments.

takeaways.label: Buybacks begin
takeaways.text: Shopify spent $562 million repurchasing stock this quarter, versus nothing a year earlier, while losses on payments and loans fell to $120 million from $148 million.

history.verdict: Growth sped up and the outlook stayed strong, so a beaten-down stock jumped.

reasons.label: Growth speeding up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 34%, ahead of the high-twenties growth Shopify had guided for this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong profit and cash
reasons.text: Free cash flow margin reached 18%, up from 16%, and operating income rose 68%.

reasons.label: Confident next-quarter outlook
reasons.text: Shopify guided Q3 revenue growth to the low thirties and free cash flow margin to the high-teens to low-twenties.
